company_name: Skydance Corporation (formerly Paramount Skydance Corporation; NYSE: SKYD, formerly Nasdaq: PSKY)

equity_bridge.note: PSKY Q3-2026 10-Q balance sheet; WBD Q2-2026 10-Q MinorityInterest (XBRL)

equity_bridge.item: Integration and restructuring cash to reach synergies, after tax
equity_bridge.note: ESTIMATE: ~6.5bn pre-tax over 2027-2029 (roughly 1x the $6bn run-rate target, plus the up-to-800 legacy Paramount programme), taxed at 23%. Not disclosed by the company for WBD. Excluded from the EBITDA margin path, which is on the company's Adjusted basis.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment -- history is not usable as a growth anchor
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Historical CAGRs are not meaningful for this entity. Revenue is the legacy standalone company only (FY2023 29,652 -> ~29,200 FY2026E, about -0.5%/yr). Equity was reset by pushdown accounting on 2025-08-07 (23,050 at FY2023 -> 13,032 at Q3-2026 is an accounting break, not a return), FY2025 is split into predecessor and successor stubs with no full-year row, EPS is negative or near zero across the series, and the share count went 652M -> 1,125M -> 5,043M through two transactions. None of it describes the combined company.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF history for the standalone company: FY2023 reported FCF 147 less SBC 177+29 = negative; FY2024 489 less 245+60 = 184; 9M-2026 385 less 262+122 = ~0. The legacy business has not produced owner FCF after interest in any recent period.

scenario_narratives.base: Two-thirds of the $6bn synergy target lands by 2030. Linear networks (CBS cable brands, TNT, CNN, Discovery, HGTV, Food) keep losing 7-9% of revenue a year, the Paramount+/HBO Max bundle launched in 2027 grows roughly 10% and reaches scale profitability, and the studios run flat with slate volatility. Revenue troughs in 2028 and returns to ~2% growth; pre-SBC EBITDA margin rises from ~19% to 25%. Unlevered owner FCF of roughly 6-10bn a year services ~6.5bn of interest with little left over, so leverage falls mainly through EBITDA growth and reaches about 4x rather than management's 3.0x by 2029. The business is valued at 12x terminal owner FCF, a multiple for a structurally slow media asset.
scenario_narratives.bull: The full $6bn of synergies is delivered on schedule, the combined streaming service holds price and churn against Netflix and Disney, the Warner Bros./Paramount/DC slates perform, and sports rights (NFL, NBA, March Madness, UEFA) keep affiliate fees declining slowly rather than quickly. Revenue grows 3%+ from 2029, margin reaches 28.5%, cash conversion improves as content spend is rationalised across two libraries, and leverage reaches ~3x near the 2029 target, allowing refinancing of the 8-9% second-lien paper. Above $12 per share the 470.7M warrants begin to dilute, which is not in the share count.
scenario_narratives.bear: Integration of a target larger than the acquirer, 14 months after the acquirer's own merger, slips: only about a third of the synergies survive reinvestment and talent loss, cord-cutting accelerates across the enlarged cable portfolio, the streaming bundle fails to lift ARPU, and an advertising downturn lands while leverage is above 6x. Revenue falls every year, margin stalls near 20%, and unlevered owner FCF of ~5bn does not cover ~6.5bn of interest. On this path enterprise value is below the debt: the equity is worth nothing without a dilutive recapitalisation, asset sales at distressed prices or sponsor support from the Ellison family. A negative modelled value here should be read as zero for a limited-liability share, and as a statement that the common stock does not survive this path unaided.

valuation_philosophy.summary: LOW-CONFIDENCE, PRO FORMA VALUATION. Read these three limits first. (a) Every filed financial statement for this company is pre-merger: the Metrics CSV, the history and the Q3-2026 10-Q describe legacy Paramount Skydance (about 29bn of revenue, 15bn of debt, 1.1bn shares). No combined or pro forma statements exist; the company has deferred them to the FY2026 10-K. (b) The quoted price and share count belong to a different, far larger and far more leveraged entity: Warner Bros. Discovery was acquired on 2026-10-06 for 97.4bn of consideration, funded by 3,918M new shares at $12.00 and 56.9bn of new secured debt, leaving ~5.04bn shares and ~87bn of gross debt. A DCF of the standalone history would not value the security that trades, so this model instead assembles a combined base from the legacy company's 10-Q, WBD's own last filings (FY2025 10-K, Q2-2026 10-Q) and the closing capital structure in the 10-Q's subsequent-event notes. (c) That assembly is an estimate, not reported fact: WBD's Adjusted EBITDA is reconstructed, closing cash is undisclosed, eliminations and purchase accounting are unknown, and integration costs are assumed. Because equity is a thin residual under ~82bn of net debt, the per-share values are highly geared to those estimates -- each 1bn of enterprise value is $0.20 a share, and a 10% change in enterprise value is more than $2. Treat the output as a map of what has to be true, not as a point estimate: the market price needs roughly the base case plus full synergy delivery; the base case alone does not support it; the bear case leaves nothing for the common. No intrinsic-value conclusion should be relied on until combined financials are reported.
key_risks_to_valuation: Pro forma base is estimated: +/-700 on FY2026E EBITDA (12,400) moves base value by roughly +/-$1.50 per share
Closing cash and any revolver repayment are undisclosed; net debt could be several billion off in either direction ($0.20 per share per 1bn)
Synergy delivery is the dominant driver: base credits ~4bn of the 6bn target, bull the full amount, bear ~2bn
Interest of ~6.5bn a year absorbs most unlevered owner FCF until synergies arrive; a refinancing or covenant problem is a solvency event, not a margin event

Bear-case enterprise value is below net debt; the modelled negative equity value means zero for the share, and if the build carries it as a negative number the weighted value is understated relative to a floored reading
470.7M warrants at $12.00 are excluded from the share count and dilute outcomes above $12
Purchase accounting in the FY2026 10-K will reset D&A, content assets and deferred taxes; cash tax and working-capital paths here are placeholders until then
Controlled company: Class B holders have no vote; the Ellison family and RedBird hold 100% of the voting stock
valuation_philosophy.negative_bear_note: The bear case builds to a negative per-share value (enterprise value below net debt). The weighted value carries that negative number as built, which is harsher than a share with limited liability can actually deliver: flooring the bear at zero gives a weighted value of about 6.40 instead of about 4.53. Both readings sit below the market price. Entry prices at the 15% hurdle are negative in all three scenarios -- there is no price at which this model returns 15% a year, because at that rate the enterprise is worth less than the debt even on the bull path.

data_sources.financials: Legacy company: PSKY_Quarterly_Q3-2026.txt (10-Q for the quarter ended 2026-09-30, including the WBD subsequent-event, equity syndication and debt notes) and PSKY_Annual_FY2025.txt. Warner Bros. Discovery: SEC XBRL companyfacts API, CIK 1437107, FY2025 10-K and Q2-2026 10-Q values, fetched 2026-11-15 -- these are NOT in the Metrics CSV or the ticker database. data_sources.qualitative: PSKY_Analysis.json (2026-11-15): synergy target, 3.0x leverage target by 2029, Q4 theatrical shortfall, consent decree, analyst reaction.

inputs.sbc_source: ESTIMATED PRO FORMA, sum of two filers. Legacy Paramount Skydance: Q3-2026 10-Q cash flow statement, 9M-2026 stock-based compensation 262 plus payroll taxes paid in lieu of issuing shares 122 (no combined company figure published, so the two lines are summed), annualised to ~510. Warner Bros. Discovery: FY2025 10-K ShareBasedCompensation 769 (SEC XBRL companyfacts, CIK 1437107) plus an assumed ~70 of withholding taxes (WBD tag not found). Total ~1,350 = 2.1% of pro forma revenue.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-11-13T21:00:03Z regular close, Yahoo symbol SKYD (info.json price_symbol redirect; the PSKY symbol is frozen at its 2026-10-22 last trade)
inputs.share_count_basis: 1,125M diluted weighted-average shares for Q3-2026 (10-Q EPS note) plus 3,918M Class B shares issued to the Equity Syndication Parties at $12.00 on 2026-10-06 (10-Q subsequent-event note) = 5,043M. Held flat because SBC is expensed in the flows. NOT included: 470.7M ten-year warrants struck at $12.00 distributed 2026-10-13 and legacy warrants struck at $30.50 -- both out of the money at the current price (treasury method = 0) but the $12 warrants would dilute any outcome above $12 by up to ~9%, which caps the bull case.
inputs.pro_forma_basis: THIS IS A PRO FORMA COMBINED MODEL, NOT A MODEL OF REPORTED FINANCIALS. The Metrics CSV and core_metrics hold only the pre-WBD standalone company (through 2026-09-30). The price and share count belong to the post-merger company, so a standalone DCF divided by either share count is not comparable to the price. The base is therefore built as legacy Paramount Skydance (Q3-2026 10-Q) + Warner Bros. Discovery as last filed (FY2025 10-K and Q2-2026 10-Q via SEC XBRL companyfacts, fetched 2026-11-15) + the closing capital structure disclosed in the Q3-2026 10-Q subsequent-event and debt notes. No combined or pro forma financial statements have been published; the company says they arrive with the FY2026 10-K.
inputs.base_revenue_build: Legacy PSKY: 9M-2026 revenue 21,285 (flat vs pro forma 9M-2025) plus an estimated Q4 of ~7,900 = ~29,200. WBD: FY2025 revenue 37,296; H1-2026 17,610 (-6.3% vs 18,791 in H1-2025), so FY2026E ~35,800. Sum ~65,000 before intercompany eliminations (unknown, assumed small). The Analysis JSON's '~$70B pro forma' is a press figure on older WBD revenue.
inputs.ebitda_base_build: FY2026E pro forma Adjusted EBITDA (pre-SBC) ~12,400 = 19.1% of revenue. Legacy PSKY: 9M-2026 Adjusted EBITDA 3,260 (10-Q MD&A) plus ~900 for Q4 = ~4,150. WBD: ~8,400, an ESTIMATE -- Adjusted EBITDA is non-GAAP and not in XBRL; rebuilt from FY2025 operating income 738 + D&A 5,684 + SBC 769 + restructuring 399 + transaction costs 166 + other impairments/items, then shaded for the H1-2026 revenue decline and management's up-to-$200M Q4 theatrical shortfall. Error band on this figure is at least +/-700.
inputs.net_debt_build: Total debt 87,100 = 15,044 carrying value at 2026-09-30 + 72,100 issued or assumed at closing (56,900 new acquisition debt: 5,000 Term A, 9,500 Term B-1, 30,000 First Lien Notes, 12,400 Second Lien Notes; 12,600 Second Lien Exchange Notes; 2,700 other assumed WBD notes). Not adjusted for any repayment of the 1,665 revolver draw at closing (not disclosed). Cash 4,746 = PSKY 1,377 at 2026-09-30 + WBD 3,369 at 2026-06-30; the post-closing cash balance is NOT disclosed and could differ by several billion in either direction (sources 47.0bn equity + 56.9bn debt against ~98bn of identified uses). Every 1,000 of net debt is $0.20 per share.
inputs.wacc_rationale: USD flows. 8.5% in every scenario (risk is carried by the scenario paths and weights, not by per-scenario rates). Cost of debt ~7.5% pre-tax (the October 2026 secured notes priced 6.30%-8.90% first lien, 8.25%-9.125% second lien), ~6.0% after tax with the interest shield only partly usable under the section 163(j) 30%-of-EBITDA limit (interest ~6.5bn against a ~3.7bn cap). Cost of equity ~11-13% (US 10-year ~4.3% + 5% ERP x levered beta 1.4-1.7). At a normalised 40-45% debt weight that blends to ~8.5%; at today's market weights (debt ~68% of EV) the arithmetic is similar because the equity cost rises as the weight falls.
inputs.lease_treatment: US GAAP ASC 842: operating lease cost sits inside Adjusted EBITDA, so lease liabilities (PSKY 1,029 + current portion; WBD 3,511 at FY2025) are NOT added to net debt. Finance leases (2) are in total debt.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are consolidated (100%); noncontrolling interests deducted once in the equity bridge at book value: PSKY 1,063 (2026-09-30) + WBD 1,157 (2026-06-30). Cash paid to NCI runs ~190 (PSKY 9M-2026) + ~145 (WBD H1-2026), so book value may understate the claim.
inputs.da_capex_treatment: da_pct_path is TAX-RELEVANT depreciation only (~2.3% of revenue: WBD FY2025 D&A 5,684 less 4,605 intangible amortisation = ~1,080; legacy Paramount ~400 before pushdown accounting). Book D&A (~7bn combined, and about to be reset by WBD purchase accounting) is mostly acquired-intangible amortisation from stock deals with no tax basis step-up; running it through EBIT would book a tax shield that does not exist. capex_pct_path = PP&E capex ~2.3% (WBD 1,231 in FY2025; PSKY 242 in 9M-2026) PLUS a content-and-working-capital cash drag (2.0% falling to 1.0% in base): legacy PSKY converted only ~1.05bn of unlevered pre-tax cash from 3,260 of 9M-2026 Adjusted EBITDA (working capital -986, content spend ahead of amortisation, restructuring cash).
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF DCF (component route), operating media company per dcf-methods routing; first valuation of this ticker. Built PRO FORMA for the post-WBD entity because the quoted price and 5.04bn share count are post-merger while every filed financial statement is pre-merger -- see pro_forma_basis. Confidence is LOW: the revenue base, EBITDA base, closing cash and purchase accounting are all estimates until the FY2026 10-K. Equity is a thin residual (market cap ~38bn under ~82bn of net debt), so a 10% change in enterprise value moves the per-share value by more than $2. reported_fcf 2,700 is the pre-merger sum (PSKY 9M-2026 OCF 627 less capex 242, annualised ~515; WBD TTM to 2026-06-30 ~2,180) and is AFTER the old interest bills (~3.3bn); the new debt stack carries roughly 6.5bn of annual interest, so pro forma levered FCF before synergies is close to zero. last_fcf = 2,700 - 1,350 SBC incl. equity taxes; interest income not stripped (net debt, not net cash). Non-repurchaser: no buybacks, a $0.05 quarterly dividend (~1.0bn/yr on the new count), and all excess cash is pledged to debt reduction, so the flat share count is a modelling convention. Pensions, equity-method investees (PSKY recorded 180 of equity losses in 9M-2026) and the redeemable NCI at WBD are not modelled. Folder and file names stay PSKY; the live symbol is SKYD.

base.growth_rationale: Roughly half of pro forma revenue is linear TV (legacy TV Media ~13bn, WBD global networks ~19bn) shrinking 7-9% a year; ~20bn of streaming growing ~10%; studios flat and slate-driven. That nets to a small decline until streaming outweighs linear around 2029-30.
base.margin_rationale: FY2026E ~19.1% pre-SBC. Base credits about two-thirds of the $6bn synergy target (~4bn, +6pp) by year 4, with linear margin loss offset by streaming scale thereafter.
base.tax_rationale: Unlevered cash tax on EBIT. 22% while integration costs are deductible, 25% blended federal/state/foreign after. The legacy company is currently receiving refunds (-67 in 9M-2026); WBD paid 1,926 in FY2025.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 12x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the house 15% to 30%: pro forma net debt is ~6.6x pre-synergy EBITDA with ~6.5bn of annual interest, the thesis rests on an unproven integration, and no combined financials exist to check it against. Base 45%: partial synergy delivery against continuing linear decline is the usual outcome of large media mergers (the 2022 Discovery-WarnerMedia deal delivered its cost cuts and still lost revenue). Bull cut from 35% to 25% because it needs synergies, streaming economics, slate performance and refinancing all to go right at once, and its upside is capped by the $12 warrants.
probability_weighted.floor_note: Memo only: 0.45 x base + 0.25 x bull with the bear case at zero rather than its modelled negative value. weighted_iv is the as-built figure.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
sanity_check.not_evaluated_reason: no rule had inputs: no annual row with revenue, equity or earnings on a known scale (core_metrics.units NULL? see make backfill-units) or no FY-end price aligned to it
